items.desc: At least 1,451 people have been displaced. Floods and landslides have completely damaged 179 houses and partially damaged 26 others, while another 270 houses are at risk, according to police.

items.title: Som Bahadur Kumal sets national record in 800-metre race
items.desc: Kumal clocks 1 minute 49.55 seconds at Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium, bettering his own national record.

items.title: Former chief justice Rana’s midnight detention leaves the chain of authority unexplained
items.desc: Police say they acted over a ‘security threat’, but have not identified it or explained why a crime investigation team was sent to take the former chief justice from his home.

items.title: Two bodies recovered from Himlung avalanche site
items.desc: Identities of the victims remain unknown as rescuers search the area after an avalanche left 14 people unaccounted for.

items.title: How did Prime Minister Shah’s address become impactful?
items.desc: Carrying a rapper background and the style of expressing certain topics directly and clearly on social media, the 'Balen vibe' is sustained in the PM’s UNGA speech.

items.title: ‘Tenzing’ puts the Sherpa at the centre of the Everest story
items.desc: Jennifer Peedom’s thrilling feature puts Tenzing Norgay’s own Everest dream at the centre of a story long dominated by Edmund Hillary—a dream that began long before the historic 1953 expedition.

items.title: Former chief justice Rana released after police take him from home
items.desc: Police cited a security threat but have yet to explain what prompted them to remove Cholendra Shumsher Rana from his Maharajgunj residence.

items.title: Floods and landslides kill 12 across Nepal
items.desc: Seven people remain missing and more than 1,100 have been evacuated as heavy rain raises the risk of further disasters.

items.title: Iran will make no nuclear concessions, Iranian official says
items.desc: Iran says it will make no nuclear concessions even if the US accepts its conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: 14 Nepalis missing on Himlung after avalanche as bad weather hampers rescue
items.desc: Helicopters are on standby in Kathmandu and Pokhara, but poor weather has so far prevented rescuers from reaching the mountain.

items.title: Flood washes away around 80 houses in Parbat as landslide kills one in Palpa
items.desc: The Kaligandaki river flooded the Farse settlement, while a landslide buried a house and a cattle shed in Palpa, leaving one dead and two missing.

items.title: What we know—and what remains unclear—about Cholendra Shumsher Rana’s detention
items.desc: Rana was taken from his home at around 3am after police cited a security threat. Hours later, questions remain over whether he was arrested, detained or taken into protective custody.

items.title: 10 missing after avalanche hits Himlung Himal
items.desc: Climbers and support staff are unaccounted for after an avalanche struck the 7,126-metre peak in Manang’s Nar Phu area.

items.title: Police say Rana brought to office after security concerns
items.desc: Authorities say the former chief justice was taken from his Maharajgunj residence after a security threat, but he faces no criminal case and will be released.

items.title: Relentless rain triggers floods, landslides across Nepal
items.desc: Floodwaters sweep away six houses in Butwal, major rivers cross danger marks in Chitwan and landslides disrupt highways and roads in several districts.

items.title: How Nepali literature should respond to political changes
items.desc: Contemporary Nepali literature does not overtly reflect the chaotic nature of today’s political climate.

items.title: Can Nepal walk the talk on green investment?
items.desc: Climate change is no longer just about emissions. It is the sum of blatant disrespect for the planet’s natural resources and their overuse.

items.title: Why Nepal’s latest disaster needs a local name—not just a scientific label
items.desc: We use words like ‘tsunami’ and ‘monsoon’ to honour the communities who know these disasters best. It’s time for Nepal to do the same.

items.title: Deuba faction moves ahead with parallel Congress convention
items.desc: Deuba’s camp will begin its ward conventions on October 1 and hold a central convention in December as the Supreme Court review of the leadership dispute remains pending.

items.title: Khanal meets UAE counterpart, thanks Abu Dhabi for $25m flood aid
items.desc: Foreign minister Shisir Khanal also holds talks with his Armenian counterpart on expanding bilateral cooperation

items.title: Flood sweeps away bridge linking Syangja and Gulmi
items.desc: The bridge over the Kaligandaki river was washed away after four days of continuous rain caused the river to swell.

items.title: Nepal’s tourism industry keeps absorbing one crisis after another — and keeps coming back
items.desc: Despite the pandemic, political unrest and natural disasters, Nepal’s tourism industry has endured, with visitors returning after each shock. But is that resilience masking the need to build a safer, more diversified tourism industry?

items.title: Fiction: A conversation by the flickering candle
items.desc: He had attended the funeral. She was laid to rest. And yet, he cannot let go, unable to grasp that she is no longer here.

items.title: Police arrest former chief justice Cholendra Shumsher Rana
items.desc: A senior police source confirmed that officers arrested Rana at his Maharajgunj residence on Sunday, with further details yet to emerge.

items.title: Incessant rains trigger widespread flooding in Tarai, disrupt key highway links across Nepal
items.desc: Swollen Narayani and Saptakoshi rivers submerge hundreds of homes in Nawalparasi West and Saptari, forcing rescues. Landslides and road erosion cut off vital routes, including Prithvi and BP highways.

items.title: For 26 years, India has searched passengers at Kathmandu airport. Nepal can’t say why
items.desc: The screening, which has run since the IC814 hijacking, was made public by India, including a record in its parliament, in 2000. In Kathmandu, three separate government agencies say they can’t find a clear paper trail authorising the practice.

items.title: Finance Minister Wagle leaves for Doha
items.desc: Wagle is expected to seek support for post-flood reconstruction and climate finance while advancing infrastructure projects with the multilateral lender.
